methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Extra Credit: Roanoke College launches AI program for professionals
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College launching an AI professional education program outside traditional tech hubs signals peer-to-peer capability building in secondary markets, potentially distributing deep skills beyond NoVA if professionals apply learning locally rather than migrating to metro centers.

signals.title: ‘Shaping our future’: Company powering AI data centers invests $50+ million in Henrico, adding 200 jobs - WWBT
signals.signal_reading: A $50M AI data center infrastructure investment in Henrico with 200 jobs concentrates advanced technical capability in Richmond Metro, reinforcing the capital-rich hub pattern while rural areas remain disconnected from the AI value chain.

signals.title: VA uses hundreds of AI systems. Veterans may not know when they’re involved. - Military Times
signals.signal_reading: Veterans interacting with hundreds of opaque VA AI systems without awareness or control exemplifies shallow, concentrated deployment—technology applied to populations rather than empowering them with AI literacy or agency.

signals.title: Virginia budget clears way for $100B Berry Hill data center campus
signals.signal_reading: Virginia's $100B Berry Hill data center campus approval reinforces NoVA's dominance as AI infrastructure capital, deepening geographic concentration of computational resources while offering little pathway for distributed skill development across other regions.

signals.title: Virginia's best-paying jobs are most exposed to AI, report says - Axios
signals.signal_reading: High-wage Virginia jobs facing AI exposure creates urgency for workforce reskilling—whether this triggers distributed peer learning networks or concentrates retraining in metro institutions will determine if disruption spreads capability or deepens divides.
